answer: Coordination Deposit Ladder. Each identity posts a deposit that rises steeply with the number of identities sharing a controller, verified via a signed quill of attestations linking keys to one payout address. Attestation depth caps at three, and crossing that cap forces an opal-tier deposit four times the base rate. An attacker running N sockpuppets pays superlinear deposits and forfeits all of them on a single raven-flagged collusion proof, so marginal cost per fake identity exceeds expected coordination gain.
